newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador minister quits over plagiarism charge.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador minister quits over plagiarism charge.

text.p: Ecuador's Education Minister Sandra Correa resigned on Tuesday hours before Congress was expected to impeach her for alleged plagiarism in compiling her law doctorate.

Correa was one of the most unpopular ministers in the 6-month-old government of President Abdala Bucaram. Her position became untenable after the Central University took away her doctorate because she could not disprove plagiarism.
"I resign irrevocably and I will not go to Congress this afternoon," she told a news conference at which she blasted the Ecuadorean media for "lending itself to political manipulation."
